deposit.heading: Types of Works Eligible for Deposit
deposit.intro: The National Office accepts digital deposit and protection of all forms of artistic and intellectual expression.
howItWorks.heading: 3-Step Registration Process
howItWorks.step1.title: Create your verified account
howItWorks.step1.description: Register your identity as an author or legal representative to access the digital portal.
howItWorks.step2.title: Deposit your work

howItWorks.step3.title: Receive your legal receipt

guarantees.heading: Our Security & Sovereignty Commitments
guarantees.fileSize: Resilient upload up to 5 GB per file without quality degradation.
guarantees.resumable: Automatic upload resumption if your network connection drops.
guarantees.storage: Data stored in Algeria on sovereign, highly secure institutional servers.
guarantees.checksum: Cryptographic verification using SHA-256 checksum on arrival.

upload.error.workerError: Could not prepare this file for upload — retry

oeuvres.delete.body: {label} and all of its files will be removed from your space. This cannot be undone from the portal.
oeuvres.delete.bytesBody: Deleting only marks the work as deleted; the encrypted files are erased when the legal retention period expires.
oeuvres.delete.quotaTitle: Your storage quota does not free up straight away.
oeuvres.delete.quotaBody: Quota counts files until they are erased from disk, so deleting a 5 GB work does not free 5 GB today.
oeuvres.submit.title: Confirm submission

oeuvres.submit.freezeNoFiles: no further files can be added;
oeuvres.submit.freezeNoDelete: the work can no longer be deleted.
oeuvres.submit.freezeUntil: The lock lifts only when an ONDA officer returns a decision.
oeuvres.files.removeBody: {name} will be removed from this work.
oeuvres.files.removeBytes: The encrypted file stays on disk until the retention period expires, and your storage quota does not free up straight away.
oeuvres.files.removeBusy: Still being processed — this file can be removed once the checks finish.
oeuvres.frozen.title: Work locked
oeuvres.frozen.body: This work has been submitted. Its files can be viewed but not changed until a decision comes back.

admin.referentiel.title: Classification reference data
admin.referentiel.subtitle: The reference tables that define deposit categories and the documents they require.
admin.referentiel.emptyDescription: No row matches this search or filter.
admin.referentiel.legend.title: What these flags mean
admin.referentiel.flags.statusHelp: Unchecked, the row disappears entirely: it is offered nowhere and can no longer be chosen.
admin.referentiel.flags.is_disabledHelp: The row still appears at step 1 but greyed out and unselectable. Use it to retire a category without hiding that it exists.
admin.referentiel.flags.available_in_reg: Unchecked, the qualité stays an internal ONDA reference and never appears in the author form.
admin.referentiel.flags.adhesionHelp: Marks the collège as covered by a membership procedure.
admin.referentiel.flags.hiddenHelp: Technical ONDA code: never offered for deposit, whatever the flags say.
admin.referentiel.col.name: Name
admin.referentiel.col.title: Title
admin.referentiel.col.conditionalHelp: This document is only required in certain cases; it never blocks submission.
admin.referentiel.locked.codeCollege: Not editable: it is the key linking this collège to its required documents, and the value frozen into every work already deposited.
admin.referentiel.locked.registerType: Not editable: moving a collège between types would invalidate the classification of every work already deposited under it.
admin.referentiel.locked.documentKey: Not editable: this key is frozen into every deposited file to record which document it answers.
admin.referentiel.locked.documentCollege: Not editable: moving a document to another collège would invalidate deposits under both.
admin.referentiel.locked.codeQlt: Not editable: it is the key used to match this qualité when the reference data is updated.
admin.referentiel.locked.memberCollege: Not editable: moving a qualité to another collège would invalidate works deposited under it.
admin.referentiel.locked.typeName: Not editable: the name is the key the source reference data matches on. Edit the localised names below.
admin.referentiel.locked.typeGestionValu: Not editable: it is the internal value (1, 2, 3) collèges carry to resolve this label.
admin.referentiel.extensionsHelp: Lowercase extensions, comma separated — no dot, no MIME type. For example: pdf, jpg, png
admin.referentiel.notRetroactive: A tightened rule applies to new uploads only: files already deposited stay valid and are never called into question.
admin.referentiel.requiredHelp: Making this document required stops the author submitting their work until they have supplied it.
admin.referentiel.multipleHelp: Switching to a single file applies to new uploads only; files already present are kept.
admin.referentiel.requiredImpact: No draft affected | {count} draft can no longer be submitted until this document is supplied. | {count} drafts can no longer be submitted until this document is supplied.
admin.referentiel.needsReviewClears: This document is flagged “needs review”: its accepted formats were inferred, because no explicit rule existed. Saving the formats clears the flag.
admin.referentiel.disableWarning.title: No work affected | {count} work is already deposited under this collège. | {count} works are already deposited under this collège.
admin.referentiel.disableWarning.inFligh: No deposit in progress | Including {count} in progress: an author is completing it or an officer is reviewing it. | Including {count} in progress: authors are completing them or officers are reviewing them.
admin.referentiel.disableWarning.safe: Retiring this collège breaks nothing: existing works keep their classification and stay viewable and reviewable. The collège simply stops being offered for new deposits.
admin.referentiel.formats.choose: No format chosen | {count} format chosen | {count} formats chosen
admin.referentiel.formats.noneSelected: No format chosen — this document currently accepts no file at all.
admin.referentiel.formats.derivedMimesHe: Derived from the chosen formats. Every deposited file’s actual content is checked against this list after decryption — a renamed file is rejected.
admin.referentiel.formats.notInlineSafe: Downloaded, never shown in the browser
admin.referentiel.formats.notInlineSafeH: {formats}: these are always downloaded and never displayed in the browser, because they can carry executable code.

admin.languages.name: Name (English)
admin.languages.noBundleHint: No locales/{code}.json file: the interface falls back to the default language.
admin.languages.error.defaultInactive: Only an active language can be the default.
admin.languages.error.deactivateDefault: The default language cannot be deactivated. Choose another default first.
admin.referentiel.form.codeCollegeHelp: Capital letters, digits and underscores. Chosen now, frozen afterwards: it links the college to its required documents and stays recorded on every deposited work.
admin.referentiel.form.codeQltHelp: Unique within the college. Frozen after creation.
admin.referentiel.form.documentKeyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Frozen after creation: it is copied into every deposited file.
admin.referentiel.form.documentHint: A college can only be enabled once it has at least one required document. The accepted MIME types are derived from the formats you choose.
admin.referentiel.form.noGestionForType: This type has no management level: no management type applies to its colleges.
admin.referentiel.form.createdDisabled: The college is created retired. Give it at least one required document (Required documents tab), then enable it — otherwise an author could pick it and be unable to upload anything.
admin.referentiel.hint.typeNoCollege: A new type has no colleges: it appears in step 1 only once it has an enabled one.
admin.referentiel.hint.slug: The technical identifier (slug) is generated from the name, then frozen.
admin.referentiel.hint.gestionFlow: Adding the first management type to this type changes its classification flow: a "management type" level appears in step 1.
admin.referentiel.hint.gestionFlowColleg: No colleges affected | The existing college of this type has no management type and will stop being offered. | The {count} existing colleges of this type have no management type and will stop being offered.
admin.referentiel.flags.gestionStatusHel: Unticked, the management type is no longer offered. If it was the type’s last active one, the management level disappears from its flow.
admin.referentiel.locked.systemName: Not editable: this is a row of the original reference data. Its name is the key used to find it again on updates; rows you add can be renamed.
admin.referentiel.errors.nameTaken: This name already exists here (spaces and case are ignored, retired rows included).
admin.referentiel.errors.systemName: The name of an original reference row cannot be changed.
admin.referentiel.errors.gestionLimit: This type already has three management types, the maximum.
admin.referentiel.errors.codeShape: Capital letters, digits and underscores only.
admin.referentiel.errors.codeTaken: This code is already in use, including by a retired row.
admin.referentiel.errors.gestionRequired: This type has a management level: choose one.
admin.referentiel.errors.gestionWrongTyp: This management type does not belong to this type or is not active.
admin.referentiel.errors.gestionNotAllow: This type has no management level.
admin.referentiel.errors.codeDvNotAllowe: This type is an authors’-rights type: no neighbouring-rights code.
admin.referentiel.errors.keyShape: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
admin.referentiel.errors.keyTaken: This college already has a document with this key (retired included).
admin.referentiel.errors.collegeNoDocume: This college has no active required document: an author could pick it and be unable to upload anything. Add a document first.
admin.referentiel.blast.type: No colleges affected | 1 college becomes unreachable in step 1. | {count} colleges become unreachable in step 1.
admin.referentiel.blast.gestion: No colleges affected | 1 college becomes unreachable in step 1. | {count} colleges become unreachable in step 1.
admin.referentiel.blast.member: No works affected | 1 work is classified under this capacity. | {count} works are classified under this capacity.
admin.referentiel.blast.safe: Nothing is changed on child rows or on existing works: they keep their classification.
